note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; the session clock's times are fictional and labelled as supplied; the recess, the kept positions, exhibits and order are as supplied and carry no legal assessment (no rule on recesses, no permitted duration, time limit, consequence or end of the proceedings; jurisdiction unspecified).

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Two identical rooms; at the same moment a ◆ marks the recess card's place in B only; the same time runs in both; only in B does the session clock stop at the supplied time with a pause badge, the recess card come out connected and the positions get marked; in A the session clock keeps running (● session active).
